summary_en: 9,100,000 shares (4.73% of S/O), ¥1,000M upper limit, open-market purchase, Aug 13, 2026–Apr 30, 2027. Stated rationale: capital efficiency, shareholder returns, and flexible deployment for M&A and restricted-stock awards.
title_en: Announcement of Decision on Treasury Share Acquisition (Share Acquisition under Articles of Incorporation pursuant to Companies Act Article 165, Paragraph 2)
translation_en_brief: FinTech Global's board of directors resolved on August 12, 2026 to acquire treasury shares pursuant to the Companies Act. The acquisition program authorizes purchase of up to 9,100,000 shares (4.73% of shares outstanding excluding treasury) for a maximum aggregate consideration of ¥1,000 million. The shares will be purchased via open-market transactions on the Tokyo Stock Exchange between August 13, 2026 and April 30, 2027. The company states its rationale as improving capital efficiency and enhancing shareholder returns, while maintaining the flexibility to redeploy acquired shares for M&A transactions or as restricted-stock awards under future compensation schemes in response to evolving business conditions.
